name: Evan M'Coll
bio: Evan M'Coll (born 1808; living 1855–57) is one of the Scottish song-writers whose lives Charles Rogers sketched in The Modern Scottish Minstrel (six volumes, Edinburgh: Adam & Charles Black, 1855–57).
This archive holds 1 song printed under this poet's name in volume 6 of the anthology, in Rogers's spelling. Dates are those given in Rogers's memoir, which is the only source used here.

poems.title: The Hills of the Heather
poems.author: Evan M'Coll
poems.text:
Give the swains of Italia
'Mong myrtles to rove,
Give the proud, sullen Spaniard
His bright orange grove;
Give gold-sanded streams
To the sons of Chili,
But, oh! give the hills
Of the heather to me.

The hills where the hunter
Oft soundeth his horn,
Where sweetest the skylark
Awakens the morn;
The gray cliff, the blue lake,
The stream's dashing glee,
Endear the red hills
Of the heather to me.

There Health, rosy virgin,
For ever doth dwell;
There Love fondly whispers
To Beauty his tale;
There Freedom's own darling!
The Gael, lives free,
Then, oh! give the hills
Of the heather to me.

poems.title: The Highland Emigrant's Last Farewell
poems.author: Evan M'Coll
poems.collection: The Oxford Book of Canadian Verse (1913)
poems.text:
Adieu, my native land ; adieu,
The banks of fair Lochfyne,
Where the first breath of life I drew,
And would my last resign !
Swift sails the bark that wafteth me
This night from thy loved strand ;
Oh, must it be my last of thee,
My dear, dear fatherland !

O Scotland ! o'er the Atlantic roar
Though fated to depart,
Nor time nor space can e'er efface
Thine image from my heart.
Come weal, come woe, till life's last throe,
My Highland home shall seem
An Eden bright in Fancy's light,
A heaven in Memory's dream !

Land of the maids of matchless grace,
The bards of matchless song,
Land of the bold heroic race
That never brooked a wrong !
Long in the front of nations free
May Scotland proudly stand ;
Farewell to thee, farewell to thee,
My dear, dear fatherland !
